caption:
The video captures a young man wearing glasses and a black hooded sweatshirt, standing indoors beneath a curved brushed-metal ceiling. A row of vertical pillars and glass panels forms the background, with an escalator faintly visible. He wears a teal band on his right wrist and a dark watch on his left wrist. In front of his torso he manipulates a toy: a glossy purple-pink ball threaded on a yellow-green string looping between his hands. Throughout the excerpt he continuously repositions his hands and forearms, crossing the string so the ball travels relative to his hands.

The purple ball shifts position, moving between chest height near his raised right hand and lower points toward his left as the string loops. His forearms cross in front of his body, temporarily occluding the ball as it emerges at different heights. At times his right hand pinches the string near his upper body while the ball hangs lower, opening the string into a triangular shape. In the later frames his right hand holds the string while his left hand opens palm-up, the string drawn taut and stretched horizontally. The sequence ends with the ball at the lower-left and the string crossed between his hands.

draft_caption:
The video captures a young man wearing glasses and a black hooded sweatshirt, standing indoors beneath a curved brushed-metal ceiling. A row of vertical pillars and glass panels forms the background, with an escalator faintly visible. He wears a teal band on his right wrist and a dark watch on his left wrist. In front of his torso, he holds a kendama toy, consisting of a glossy purple-pink ball attached by a yellow-green string to a handle. Throughout the excerpt, he continuously repositions his hands and forearms, crossing the string so the ball travels relative to his hands.

The purple ball shifts position, starting high near his raised right hand before dropping toward his left. His forearms cross in front of his body, temporarily occluding the ball as it emerges at different heights. His right hand pinches the string near his upper body while the ball hangs lower, opening the string into a triangular shape. In the later frames, his right hand grips the handle while his left hand opens palm-up, the string drawn taut and swung horizontally. The sequence ends with the ball at the lower-left and the string crossed between his hands.

review_issues.quote: his right hand grips the handle
review_issues.problem: There is no handle to grip; in the later frames the right hand pinches or holds the string itself.

review_issues.quote: the string drawn taut and swung horizontally
review_issues.problem: The frames show the string held taut and stretched horizontally between the hands, but no horizontal swinging sweep of the string is evidenced; 'swung' overstates the visible motion.
